Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option A 21.0 to 21.8 s. Same close street-flood shot: the stopped white car with water at its sills, empty headrests in the windows, its amber lamps blinking. The car and water hold still. Caption below the car.
